background.text: [0001] This invention is in the field of natural language processing, as it relates to the use of unified geometric control - line, triangle, square, cross, circle, and curvature elements - for the design and operation of a. [0002] Conventional natural language processing products address only isolated aspects of their task. A product may optimize one parameter while leaving geometry, decision branching, and tolerance flow to ad-hoc design choices made late in development, when change is most expensive. The result is a Paraphrase detector whose parts fit by adjustment rather than by design. [0003] Geometry in conventional practice is handled by general-purpose drafting or modeling tools that record shape without recording intent. When a dimension shifts, there is no single origin to re-solve from, so tolerance stack-ups accumulate silently across interfaces and the Paraphrase detector drifts from its rated NODES of 32. [0004] Decision branching in conventional natural language processing products is typically hard-coded: operating modes, configuration paths, and fallback behaviors are fixed at build time. When conditions change, the Paraphrase detector cannot re-derive its own behavior because the branching was never expressed as a solvable structure. [0005] Further, conventional builds produce no machine-readable record of what was decided and why. Verification depends on human-readable documents that drift from the built article, so two units built to the same drawing can differ in behavior without any detectable trace. [0006] There remains a need for a that collapses shape, rule, and dimension into one controlled origin and re-expands through six defined tools, that expresses branching as solvable geometry, and that emits a machine-readable build record with every unit.

summary.text: SUMMARY OF THE INVENTION [0007] The present invention provides a forced through a universal reverse reduction algorithm. The Paraphrase detector comprises six-tool mapped elements wherein LINE, TRIANGLE, SQUARE, CROSS, CIRCLE, and CURVATURE jointly define the Paraphrase detector, key parameters including NODES of 32 and THROUGHPUT of 27,000 req/s, and a machine-readable autoread block ending STATUS=SIGNATURE-1 VALID. [0008] It is an object of the invention to provide: (a) a single solvable origin from which all geometry of the Paraphrase detector is re-derivable; (b) line-path control of data flow path through the paraphrase detector pipeline; (c) triangle-hierarchy control of decision hierarchy fanning from the paraphrase detector core; (d) square-bound control of memory and system bounds containing the paraphrase detector; (e) cross-branch decision control of branch logic where paraphrase detector paths intersect; (f) circle-node anchoring of nodes and endpoints orbiting the paraphrase detector; and (g) curvature-flow shaping of load and latency curves shaping paraphrase detector behavior. [0009] It is a further object to express every operating decision of the Paraphrase detector as a reversed allowance path: seed the Signature-One grid to anchor the Paraphrase detector as a binary-1 identity, set the finished function as the destination on the infinite line and back-solve, route the target through the six tools, admit human variance in perspective, chance, and tolerance slop, and emit the Paraphrase detector as one valid build among infinite option paths. [0010] In one embodiment the Paraphrase detector is configured to operate at NODES of 32 and THROUGHPUT of 27,000 req/s, within COMPRESSION of 5.5:1, and the autoread block records the as-built parameters with each unit. In alternative embodiments the six tools are re-weighted for past, current, or future operating eras without changing the origin.

abstract.detailed: A Paraphrase detector for natural language processing is disclosed. The Paraphrase detector unifies six geometric control tools - line paths, triangle hierarchies, square bounds, cross branches, circle nodes, and curvature flow - in a single solvable origin, and forces every build decision through a reversed universal allowance algorithm, so that geometry, decision branching, and tolerance flow are designed together instead of being left to ad-hoc choice. In one embodiment the Paraphrase detector (10) comprises a control core (100) coupled to a line-path module (110) governing data flow path through the paraphrase detector pipeline, a triangle hierarchy unit (120) governing decision hierarchy fanning from the paraphrase detector core, a square bound frame (130) bounding memory and system bounds containing the paraphrase detector, a cross decision branch (140) deciding branch logic where paraphrase detector paths intersect, a circle node anchor (150) anchoring nodes and endpoints orbiting the paraphrase detector, and a curvature flow shaper (160) shaping load and latency curves shaping paraphrase detector behavior. The control core (100) is further coupled to an autoread block (170) that emits a machine-readable record of the build ending STATUS=SIGNATURE-1 VALID. In operation the Paraphrase detector runs five reversed-allowance steps in order - universal-bit starter, reverse-target, combinatorial mix, human variance, and multi-path solved reality - to yield the Paraphrase detector at NODES of 32 and THROUGHPUT of 27,000 req/s, with the geometry of every step traceable through the six tools.

technical.field_statement: [0001] This invention relates to natural language processing, and more particularly to a with unified six-tool geometry control through a reversed universal allowance algorithm.
technical.description_numbered: [0011] Referring to FIG. 1, one embodiment of the Paraphrase detector (10) is constructed by collapsing all shape, rule, and dimension into one controlled origin and re-expanding through the six tools. A control core (100) anchors the origin and sequences the five reversed-allowance steps. [0012] The control core (100) holds the binary-1 identity seeded at universal-bit starter (310): a single declared origin from which every downstream dimension is derived, so that no geometry exists without a recorded parent decision. [0013] The line-path module (110) governs data flow path through the paraphrase detector pipeline. All linear extents, alignments, and signal or load paths of the Paraphrase detector are projected from the origin through the line-path module, which fixes direction before magnitude. [0014] The triangle hierarchy unit (120) governs decision hierarchy fanning from the paraphrase detector core. Layered dependencies - primary, secondary, and tertiary functions of the Paraphrase detector - are stacked as triangle hierarchies so that a change at the apex propagates deterministically to the base. [0015] The square bound frame (130) bounds memory and system bounds containing the paraphrase detector. The operating envelope of the Paraphrase detector is enclosed in square bounds that define hard limits; nothing in the design may cross a bound without triggering a re-solve from the origin. [0016] The cross decision branch (140) decides branch logic where paraphrase detector paths intersect. Operating modes and configuration paths are expressed as cross branches - explicit, solvable forks rather than hard-coded switches - so the Paraphrase detector re-derives its behavior when conditions change. [0017] The circle node anchor (150) anchors nodes and endpoints orbiting the paraphrase detector. Reference nodes of the Paraphrase detector are fixed as circle anchors: radial datums that hold position while surrounding geometry flexes within tolerance. [0018] The curvature flow shaper (160) shapes load and latency curves shaping paraphrase detector behavior. Transitions between states, surfaces, or phases of the Paraphrase detector follow curvature flow, eliminating sharp discontinuities that would otherwise concentrate stress, error, or loss. [0019] Referring to FIG. 2, the Paraphrase detector is rated at NODES of 32 and THROUGHPUT of 27,000 req/s. The parametric diagram plots the two against each other within COMPRESSION of 5.5:1; the shaded envelope marks the region in which all six tools remain inside their square bounds. Operation outside the envelope forces a re-solve rather than a silent drift. [0020] The autoread block (170) emits, for each built unit, a machine-readable record of the as-built parameters, the tool mapping, and the five algorithm steps, terminated by STATUS=SIGNATURE-1 VALID. Two units built to the same origin carry comparable records, so behavioral drift is detectable without human-readable documents. [0021] Referring to FIG. 3, the reversed universal allowance algorithm begins at universal-bit starter (310): the Signature-One grid is seeded to anchor the Paraphrase detector as a binary-1 identity, establishing the single origin. [0022] At reverse-target (320), the finished function of the Paraphrase detector is set as the destination on the infinite line and the design is back-solved toward the origin, so every intermediate decision is justified by the destination it serves. [0023] At combinatorial mix (330), the target is routed through the six tools - line paths, triangle hierarchies, square bounds, cross branches, circle nodes, curvature flow - and each tool claims the geometry that belongs to it, with conflicts resolved by re-solving from the origin. [0024] At human variance (340), perspective, chance, and tolerance slop are admitted in the execution of the Paraphrase detector: the design holds its rated NODES of 32 while tolerating the real-world variation of builders, operators, and environments. [0025] At multi-path solved reality (350), the Paraphrase detector is emitted as one valid build among infinite option paths - the path that satisfies the destination, the six tools, and the tolerance band together. [0026] In operation, the control core (100) sequences steps (310)-(350) in order for each build or operating session of the Paraphrase detector, then verifies the autoread block (170) before release. A failed verification returns the Paraphrase detector to reverse-target (320) rather than shipping a drifted unit. [0027] Means of manufacture follow the six-tool sequence: source materials to print tolerance, form the primary structure, fit interfaces and seals, assemble subassemblies, finish and protect surfaces, and run calibration and QA burn-in with the autoread block stamped on the unit. [0028] Alternative embodiments re-weight the six tools for past, current, or future operating eras: a past-era embodiment favors proven line and square geometry; a future-era embodiment favors cross-branch adaptability and curvature flow. The origin and the five steps are unchanged. [0029] The invention is not limited to the embodiments described. Any system that collapses shape, rule, and dimension into one controlled origin, re-expands through the six defined tools, and emits the machine-readable build record falls within the scope of the appended claims.

how_it_works: Start with one controlled origin point - the 'binary-1' anchor - so the whole Paraphrase detector grows from a single known-good state.
Aim at the job it must do and work backwards, which locks the nodes of 32 target before any code is written.

Run the design through six shapes: lines for data flow path through the paraphrase detector pipeline, triangles for decision hierarchy fanning from the paraphrase detector core, squares for memory and system bounds containing the paraphrase detector, crosses for branch logic where paraphrase detector paths intersect, circles for nodes and endpoints orbiting the paraphrase detector, and curves for load and latency curves shaping paraphrase detector behavior.
Allow human-style slack - perspective, chance, tolerance - so the Paraphrase detector behaves sanely under real load.
Ship the finished Paraphrase detector as one valid build, with a machine-readable autoread block emitted on every deploy.
